title: The Stormbrood Sanctuary
description: An emerald dragon shelters her ivory clutch in the ruins of a river watchtower. Vast black storm wings, a curling armoured tail, ivory horns and a watchful open jaw turn an abandoned crossing into a nursery.

sections.name: Four planted feet and muscular haunches
Connected torso and sculpted emerald armour
Open jaw, nostrils, watching eyes and swept horns
The abandoned crossing becomes a nursery
